module.purpose: Renders one organization-owned team in the list of teams outside the user's primary organization, providing team information, navigation, link copying, preview, editing, and disbanding actions.
module.summary: This React component presents a team list item with branding-aware identity information and an action menu. It derives the team URL from organization branding or a public website environment setting, conditionally enables link and preview actions for published teams, copies links through the browser clipboard, displays success feedback, and opens a confirmation dialog before invoking the supplied disband action.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administration of additional teams and their public profiles. Failure prevents administrators from locating, previewing, editing, or disbanding these teams.
classes: Props (~L17-24): Defines team data and interaction state required by the list item
functions: OtherTeamListItem (~L26-161): Renders team details and organization management actions

io: Writes the published team URL to navigator.clipboard when the link button is activated.
Displays a success toast after initiating clipboard write.
env: Reads process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBSITE_URL to construct fallback team URLs.

edgeCases.behavior: Returns an empty fragment instead of rendering the list item.
Displays Unpublished team and omits copy-link and preview controls.

edgeCases.inputShape: Team with slug and organization branding
edgeCases.behavior: Uses orgBranding.fullDomain to construct displayed, copied, and preview URLs.

edgeCases.inputShape: Team with slug without organization branding
edgeCases.behavior: Uses NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBSITE_URL-based fallback URLs for displayed, copied, and preview links.

invariants.description: The component expects a team-shaped value but renders no content when team is falsy.
Published team actions are available only when team.slug is truthy.
The disband callback runs only after the confirmation dialog's confirm action.

assumptions.description: The parent supplies onActionSelect to perform the actual team disband operation.
The parent controls hideDropdown and updates it through setHideDropdown.
NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBSITE_URL is available when organization branding is absent and a URL is needed.
The team object follows the listOtherTeams RouterOutputs shape and supplies id, name, logoUrl, and slug fields.

ambiguities.question: Does the clipboard API failure need user-visible handling outside this component?

concurrencyModel.notes: Rendering and event callbacks are synchronous from this file's perspective; clipboard write is initiated without awaiting or handling its promise.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the team prop is absent, the component renders no team list item.
moduleContractTests.then: the rendered output is an empty fragment
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the early-return behavior for missing team data.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When a published team has a slug, selecting the link button copies its URL and reports success.
moduleContractTests.then: navigator.clipboard.writeText is called with the team URL and showToast is called with t("link_copied") and "success"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the published-team copy-link interaction and success feedback.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the disband confirmation is accepted, the component emits the disband action.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the destructive action contract exposed to the parent.
